rise_rule._prov: DERIVED from the camera azimuth. No list of faces is authored.
rise_rule.rule: a wall rises to wall_rise_m iff its INNER normal n satisfies n . SE > 0 where SE = (+1,-1)/sqrt(2); otherwise it is cut to near_cut_m.
rise_rule.consequence: rising: apse wall, transept NORTH walls, nave/chancel WEST arcade, west transept end wall.  cut low: south facade, transept SOUTH walls, nave/chancel EAST arcade, east transept end wall.

transform.derivation: (a) the re-ruling puts the apse NORTH and the entry SOUTH; (b) the bbox 57.285 x 76.665 is not square so +-90 deg cannot map bbox to bbox; (c) 0 deg keeps the apse south and is refuted by (a). 180 deg is forced.

pool_registration.radius_caveat: radius_disjoint = upper_bound * k_disjoint. The INTERIOR POINTS are MEASURED; the RADII are an upper bound scaled by drax's k_disjoint call. Every overlap verdict is recomputed at BOTH radii and flagged if it flips.
